title: Structural tensor pullback sections commute with etale restrictions
statement: For schemes X,Y, g:Y→X, modules F on X and G on Y, and psi:g*F→G, the structural pullback section maps on U and V commute with the restriction associated to every morphism h:V→U in X.Etale and its base change. The coefficient maps are exactly qcoherentPullbackSection, with the pullback projections and their canonical commutativity proof. No cohomology, quasi-coherence or compactness is involved. Notions: [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [lem-weil-pbc-qcoherent-pullback-sections-map], [def-weil-pbc-etale-tensor-sections-restriction].

proof.text: For an arbitrary family L_f left adjoint to scheme pushforward f_*, define its global-section unit and normalized composition comparison. Evaluate unit_conjugateEquiv_symm on the whole scheme; pushforwardComp is sectionwise identity there. Hence two successive section units followed by the normalized comparison equal the unit for the composite. Naturality of the adjunction unit gives naturality of section units in module morphisms. These are the fully proved private sectionsUnit_comp and sectionsUnit_naturality helpers.

Specialize Adjunction.leftAdjointCompIso_assoc. Verify the right-adjoint coherence by extensionality on module sections, where pushforward composition has identity components. Combining this equality with section-unit composition and naturality proves tripleSections. Eliminate the two triangle equalities to obtain restrictionOfAdjunction_comp: normalized section restrictions compose for arbitrary scheme triangles. Keep these calculations generic in the family of left adjoints until the final theorem. All these helpers are proved here; no etaleness of the intervening maps is assumed.

Cancel the invertible composition maps in their forward associativity equation to obtain composition_inverse. Evaluate on global sections and use section-unit naturality. Equality elimination for a composed with b equals c yields composition_restriction: the inverse comparison for c and g intertwines the triangle restriction for b followed by g with the corresponding restriction on L_g F. The family L and its adjunctions remain abstract throughout these calculations.

The fully proved private square_sections theorem takes two triangles over X, their two counterparts over Y, the projection commutativity equations, and coefficient naturality. Apply restrictionOfAdjunction_comp to both paths and identify their composites by the projection equation using restrictionOfAdjunction_congr. This gives ht, the equality of the two pairs of forward triangle restrictions. Apply composition_restriction to k,a-prime,b-prime,g, then combine ht, that inverse-comparison equation and coefficient naturality using the elementary categorical lemma combine_triangles. In the public theorem, the pullback lift equation gives the required projection commutativity, and etaleTensorSectionsMap_naturality gives coefficient naturality. Specialize square_sections to the pinned tensor adjunctions. The proved private compOfAdjunction_tensor and restrictionOfAdjunction_tensor equalities identify its generic operations with the named tensor-section maps. Unfold the two public section-map formulas and reassociate, leaving the tensor construction abstract. This proves the original additive-map square without extra assumptions or any new sorry.

theorem qcoherentPullbackSection_naturality {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) (ψ : (tensorPullback g).obj F ⟶ G)
    {U V : X.Etale} (h : V ⟶ U) :
    etaleTensorSectionsRestriction F h ≫
        qcoherentPullbackSection g F G ψ V
          ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @AlgebraicGeometry.Etale ⊤ g).obj V)
          (pullback.fst V.hom g) pullback.condition =
      qcoherentPullbackSection g F G ψ U
          ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @AlgebraicGeometry.Etale ⊤ g).obj U)
          (pullback.fst U.hom g) pullback.condition ≫
        etaleTensorSectionsRestriction G
          ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @AlgebraicGeometry.Etale ⊤ g).map h)
